landing.metaTitle: Finance Tracker — income and expenses for yourself and for a group
landing.metaDescription: Record your own income and expenses. Start a group, invite people by nickname, and see the shared totals plus who added each entry.
landing.kicker: On your own and with other people
landing.title: Your money. And shared money, if you are in a group.
landing.lead: Record income and expenses even if you are tracking alone. If the budget is shared, start a group: you see the total and who added each entry. Your personal numbers stay separate from the group's.

index.personalText: Income or an expense, an amount, and a category. A group is optional: you can track on your own.
index.groupTitle: A group when the budget is shared
index.groupText: Create a group and invite people by nickname. An invitation can be accepted, declined, or cancelled.
index.sharedText: In a group, the period you pick shows how much came in and how much went out for everyone together.
index.peopleText: A group entry is signed with the person who added it. Your personal statistics stay separate from the shared ones.

landing.featuresLead: You add the entries yourself. There is no bank connection.

features.operationsText: Amount, date, category, and a comment if you want one. An entry stays yours or goes into a group.
features.categoriesTitle: Categories with a color and an icon
features.categoriesText: Groceries, home, and transport do not collapse into one list: each category has its own color and icon.
features.invitesText: The group author finds a person by nickname. That person accepts the invitation or declines it.
features.groupStatText: Income or expenses of everyone in the group, by category, for the dates you choose.
features.personalStatText: The same charts, but only for your entries. Group totals do not mix into them.
features.authorText: In the group list, each entry shows a name. You can tell whose expense or income it is.
features.periodText: A day, a week, a month, a year, or your own dates. Income and expenses are viewed separately.
features.mappingText: A personal category can be linked to a group one, so your records and the shared ones stay aligned.

faq.familyQ: Is this only for a family?
faq.familyA: No. Personal tracking works on its own. A group is for when the summary should be shared with a family or a team.
faq.inviteQ: How does someone join a group?
faq.inviteA: The group author finds a person by nickname and sends an invitation. The invitee accepts or declines it.
faq.categoriesQ: How are personal categories different from group ones?
faq.categoriesA: Personal categories stay yours. A group has its own set. A personal category can be linked to a group one so the statistics line up.
faq.statsQ: What does the statistics view show?
faq.statsA: Income or expenses by category for the selected period. You can look at a personal summary or the summary of a selected group.
faq.bankQ: Do I need to connect a bank?
faq.bankA: No. You add operations yourself: type, amount, and category.
